arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Match occlusion of head/arms rather than moving hands for visibility. True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, shadows, halos, extra objects, text or duplicate figure. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours.  Exactly TWO arms total, one left and one right, and exactly TWO hands total. Standing with head facing SCREEN-RIGHT, one visible eye, eyebrow, nose, mouth. BOTH arms raised bent close around head: screen-left elbow sticks outward beside face with hand near the forehead/cap, screen-right arm loops above/right of the head with hand high over cap. Match the asymmetry and small gap above the head from the first reference. Not a wide V or straight overhead arms. Two hands only, neither extra arm hanging. Keep original straight standing legs and two distinct offset shoes pointing right.
